title: Smoked Salmon Skewers with African Spices
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make appetizer or side dish, perfect for summer gatherings. This recipe combines the rich taste of smoked salmon with the bold flavors of Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: Kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: A mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: 2. Cut the smoked salmon into 1-inch (2.5cm) pieces.
3. In a small bowl, mix together Kenyan spices, lime juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
4. Thread the salmon pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
5. Brush the skewers with the spice mixture, making sure each piece of salmon is coated.
6. Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
7. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
